email.subject: Mainline Plumbing: a couple quick fixes
email.body:
Marcus,

Looked at Mainline Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call on mobile, so anyone searching for a plumber from their phone has to manually dial or type your number instead of tapping once — and there's no booking option, so people who want to schedule outside business hours just leave. Smaller issues: the homepage title doesn't mention Harbor Falls or plumbing clearly, hours aren't listed, and some images are slowing the page down.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd fix first.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
